text_block_list.text:
The curtain falls on Ines Fujin's<n>Japanese Derby
experience. Her<n>dream of becoming the Derby
champion is over.

Even amid the raucous support for<n>the new Derby
champion, there are<n>those in the audience who
cheer for<n>Ines Fujin, who ran as she wanted<n>to, and
gave the race all she had.

Summoning the last of her strength,<n>Ines Fujin
gives the crowd a huge<n>wave.

The moment she returns to the<n>waiting room,
however, Ines Fujin<n>collapses to the floor...
